caption: The video showcases a dimly lit wood-paneled cabin bedroom at night, where a log fire burns in a white fireplace on the right. Throughout the video the flames flicker continuously, rising and falling in height, shape, and brightness from moment to moment. This movement sends a shifting orange glow across the hearth, the patterned rug, and the nearby surfaces. To the left, a glowing yellow table lamp rests on a nightstand, casting warm light onto two framed prints above a bed with stacked pillows and a folded dark throw; one print shows an antlered deer, and a wisp of smoke drifts from a small holder. A curtained window in the back reveals snow-dusted pine trees under a pale sky. A metal shelf stands beside the fireplace, and a framed boat picture hangs above the mantel, where two lit candles stand. The camera framing remains constant, with no pan, tilt, or zoom, while most furnishings hold fixed positions.
